vision3d.question: What file formats do you accept for source drawings?
vision3d.answer: We work from CAD, Revit, SketchUp, and PDF drawing sets. If you're unsure, send what you have and we'll advise.

vision3d.question: What is the typical turnaround for a still render?
vision3d.answer: Most single exterior or interior renders are delivered within 7-10 business days from final drawing approval.

vision3d.question: How many revision rounds are included?
vision3d.answer: Every project includes two rounds of revisions. Additional rounds are billed at an hourly rate.

printforge-3d.question: What materials do you print in?
printforge-3d.answer: PLA, PETG, and ABS for most orders, plus resin for high-detail figurines. Ask about material options during your consultation or in your order note.

printforge-3d.question: Do you do custom/one-off designs?
printforge-3d.answer: Yes — that's exactly what the free design consultation is for. Send us your idea and we'll tell you what's possible before you pay for anything.

printforge-3d.question: How long does an order take?
printforge-3d.answer: Ready-made shop items ship within 2-3 business days. Custom prints depend on complexity — we'll give you a timeline during your consultation.

question.en: How do I place an order?

answer.en: Add the items you want to your cart, fill in your name and preferred payment method, and tap "Place Order" — this opens WhatsApp with your order ready to send. We'll confirm availability and payment details there.
answer.mr: तुम्हाला हवे असलेले दागिने कार्टमध्ये टाका, तुमचे नाव आणि पसंतीची पेमेंट पद्धत भरा आणि "ऑर्डर द्या" दाबा — यामुळे तुमची ऑर्डर तयार असलेले व्हॉट्सॲप उघडेल. आम्ही तिथेच उपलब्धता आणि पेमेंटची माहिती कन्फर्म करू.

question.en: Does the jewellery tarnish or fade?
question.mr: दागिने काळे पडतात किंवा रंग उडतो का?

answer.en: Our pieces are anti-tarnish plated and last for years with normal care — avoid perfume/water contact and store in the pouch provided.
answer.mr: आमचे दागिने अँटी-टार्निश प्लेटेड आहेत आणि नीट काळजी घेतल्यास वर्षानुवर्षे टिकतात — परफ्यूम/पाण्याचा संपर्क टाळा आणि दिलेल्या पाऊचमध्ये ठेवा.

question.en: Can I return or exchange an item?
question.mr: मी वस्तू परत करू शकते का किंवा बदलून घेऊ शकते का?

answer.en: Yes — message us on WhatsApp within 3 days of delivery if there's a defect or sizing issue, and we'll arrange an exchange.
answer.mr: हो — डिलिव्हरीनंतर ३ दिवसांच्या आत काही दोष किंवा साइजची अडचण असल्यास व्हॉट्सॲपवर आम्हाला कळवा, आम्ही बदलून देऊ.
